metadata.title: A short proof of the universality of the fundamental shadow links
metadata.abstract: We give a constructive three-dimensional proof of Costantino and Thurston's universality theorem for fundamental shadow links. More precisely, every compact connected oriented three-manifold with empty or toroidal boundary can be obtained by integral Dehn filling along a subset of the boundary components of a fundamental shadow link exterior.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 经典定理的构造性新证明
analysis.workSummary: 作者给出 Costantino–Thurston 基本影链环普适性定理的三维构造性证明：任意紧、连通、定向三维流形，边界为空或由环面组成，都可由某个基本影链环外部沿部分边界分量作整数 Dehn 填充得到。
analysis.breakthrough: 贡献在证明方法的简化与构造性，不是首次建立这项普适性结论；允许只填充部分边界以保留所需环面边界。
analysis.limitations: 须保留紧、连通、定向及空或环面边界条件；摘要未给构造复杂度或填充系数界，不能推断定量最优性。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
